name: radio-group
title: Radio Group
description: HBD radio group: a real <fieldset>/<legend> radiogroup built on Radix RadioGroup with the legacy .hbd-* BEM classes re-applied. Roving-tabindex keyboard model (ArrowUp/Down/Left/Right move + select, Home/End), vertical or horizontal orientation, per-option label + hint, and field error wiring (aria-invalid/aria-describedby/role=alert). Controlled value + onValueChange (legacy { value, name } detail), optional defaultValue, and items[] prop or <RadioGroup.Item> children.
